summary.name: Audio (Wikipedia disambiguation page)
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia disambiguation page listing the various meanings of the word "audio", mainly covering sound, entertainment works and the HTML audio tag.
use_cases: look up what the word audio means
find an article on digital audio or audio signals
find the HTML audio tag reference
locate a song or album titled Audio
summary.what_it_does: This is a Wikipedia disambiguation page, not a software tool. It lists meanings of the word "audio": sound as an electrical signal, audio frequency, digital audio, stereophonic audio, and audio equipment. It also lists entertainment items such as the group AUDIO, the Blue Man Group album, Audio magazine (1947 to 2000), and songs by LSD and Black Eyed Peas. The computing entry points to the HTML audio tag.
notable: Disambiguation hub linking to multiple Wikipedia articles
Covers sound, entertainment and HTML audio tag meanings

caveats: Not a software tool; the awesome-selfhosted listing appears to be a mismatch with this page's content
